title: The Promise of the Crescent Cove
author: Wren Hartwell
blurb: Mirabel Delacroix, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
